items.source: The default content-type for views: "text/html;charset=UTF-8".
items.translation: 视图的默认 `content-type`："text/html;charset=UTF-8"。

items.source: Return the default charset, used when the content type does not contain one.
items.translation: 返回默认字符集，在content type不包含该字符集时使用。

items.source: Default is UTF-8.
items.translation: 默认值为UTF-8。

items.source: Return the configured media types supported by this view.
items.translation: 返回此视图支持的配置媒体类型。

items.source: The default value is Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE, meaning non-ordered.
Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。

items.source: Base class for ViewResolver implementations with shared properties.
items.translation: 包含共享属性的 ViewResolver 实现类的基类。

items.source: Set the default charset for this view, used when the content type does not contain one.
items.translation: 为此视图设置默认字符集，在 内容类型 不包含字符集时使用。

items.source: Get the order value of this object.
Specify the order value for this ViewResolver bean.
items.translation: 为此 ViewResolver Bean 指定顺序值。

items.source: Set the supported media types for this view.
items.translation: 为此视图设置支持的媒体类型。
`getOrder` 接口 `Ordered` 中
